comments.author: @worldwaystravel4k
comments.text: Honestly, I think I could manage a month here — the idea of everything arriving by boat and then moving through those narrow alleys on donkeys or by hand is oddly appealing. The shot of cargo strapped onto the donkeys' backs really drove home how the whole island runs without cars, and the walk from the dock straight into the old town looked beautiful. It makes you wonder what the place sounds like — probably just the sea, the boats, and hooves instead of engines. Great episode, Lamu is a gem I had never heard of before this.
